title: Seal wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyG' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9fb8c8'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#7f9db0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6b8a9e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='bellyG' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d6e4ec'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b8cede'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tail fins -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='78' rx='12' ry='5' fill='#7f9db0' transform='rotate(-25 16 78)'/>
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='84' rx='12' ry='5' fill='#6b8a9e' transform='rotate(15 18 84)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='70' rx='32' ry='24' fill='url(#bodyG)'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='74' rx='19' ry='16' fill='url(#bellyG)'/>
  <!-- front flipper -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='72' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#6b8a9e' transform='rotate(20 30 72)'/>

  <ellipse cx='80' cy='68' rx='7' ry='15' fill='#6b8a9e' transform='rotate(-25 80 68)'/>

  <ellipse cx='52' cy='40' rx='24' ry='22' fill='url(#bodyG)'/>

  <ellipse cx='52' cy='49' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#d6e4ec'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='43' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#4a5d6b'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='48' r='1' fill='#4a5d6b'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='48' r='1' fill='#4a5d6b'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='38' y1='47' x2='24' y2='43' stroke='#c8d9e4' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='50' x2='24' y2='52' stroke='#c8d9e4' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='47' x2='80' y2='43' stroke='#c8d9e4' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='50' x2='80' y2='52' stroke='#c8d9e4' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='33' y='31' width='16' height='11' rx='4' fill='#2b3a4a'/>
  <rect x='55' y='31' width='16' height='11' rx='4' fill='#2b3a4a'/>
  <rect x='34' y='32' width='7' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#6fe3ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='56' y='32' width='7' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#6fe3ff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='48' y='34' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#3f5468'/>
  <rect x='30' y='33' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#3f5468'/>
  <rect x='71' y='33' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#3f5468'/>
